# Table

Data in rows and columns with header cells.

- Status: implemented
- Category: data
- Pattern: WAI-ARIA APG “table”; HTML `<table> with <caption>, <th scope>`
- Text style: `label` (`.nd-text-label`)

## Anatomy

- **caption**: Names the table.
- **header**: Header cells with scope.
- **row**: Lines between rows; a hover tint.
- **state** (optional): A row spanning every column for loading, empty or error: a .nd-state with a sentence, a hint and, for an error, a way to try again.

## Variants

- `default`: Scrolls horizontally inside its own region on narrow screens.

## States

- `default`
- `row-hover`
- `loading`: Placeholder rows (skeleton, aria-hidden) keep the layout; the region is aria-busy and a status message says what is loading.
- `empty`: A sentence that says nothing matches or nothing exists yet, and what to do next; not an empty frame.
- `error`: The error glyph and a sentence that says what failed, with a way to try again; data already shown stays.

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | To the scroll region when it overflows. |

## Accessibility

- Role: table
- Name: Its caption.
- An overflowing table sits in a focusable region with a label (1.4.10).
- Loading, empty and error are announced through a status region (role=status); the placeholder rows are hidden from assistive technology.

WCAG 2.2 success criteria:

- 1.3.1 Info and Relationships (A)
- 1.4.10 Reflow (AA)
- 2.1.1 Keyboard (A)
- 4.1.3 Status Messages (AA)

## Platforms

| Platform | Implementation |
| --- | --- |
| web | table.nd-table |
| ios | Table (macOS, iPad) or a List of rows |
| android | a LazyColumn of rows |
| flutter | DataTable |

Web: `.nd-table` in kit.css; modifiers `.nd-state`, `.nd-table__state`.

## Web example

From the reference page:

```html
<div class="nd-stack">
  <div
    class="nd-table-region"
    role="region"
    aria-label="Example table"
    tabindex="0"
  >
    <table class="nd-table">
      <caption>
        Release checks
      </caption>
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th scope="col">Check</th>
          <th scope="col">State</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr>
          <td>Contrast pairs</td>
          <td><span class="nd-badge" data-status="success">Passed</span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td>Platforms</td>
          <td><span class="nd-badge" data-status="warning">Running</span></td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>
  <div
    class="nd-table-region"
    role="region"
    aria-label="Loading table"
    aria-busy="true"
    tabindex="0"
  >
    <table class="nd-table">
      <caption>
        Release history
      </caption>
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th scope="col">Release</th>
          <th scope="col">Date</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr aria-hidden="true">
          <td><span class="nd-skeleton"></span></td>
          <td><span class="nd-skeleton"></span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr aria-hidden="true">
          <td><span class="nd-skeleton"></span></td>
          <td><span class="nd-skeleton"></span></td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
    <p class="nd-visually-hidden" role="status">
      Loading the release history
    </p>
  </div>
  <div
    class="nd-table-region"
    role="region"
    aria-label="Empty table"
    tabindex="0"
  >
    <table class="nd-table">
      <caption>
        Open inquiries
      </caption>
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th scope="col">Inquiry</th>
          <th scope="col">Received</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr>
          <td class="nd-table__state" colspan="2">
            <div class="nd-state" data-state="empty" role="status">
              <p class="nd-state__title">No open inquiries</p>
              <p class="nd-state__body">
                New inquiries from the contact form appear here.
              </p>
            </div>
          </td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>
  <div
    class="nd-table-region"
    role="region"
    aria-label="Failed table"
    tabindex="0"
  >
    <table class="nd-table">
      <caption>
        Deployments
      </caption>
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th scope="col">Service</th>
          <th scope="col">State</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr>
          <td class="nd-table__state" colspan="2">
            <div class="nd-state" data-state="error" role="status">
              <p class="nd-state__title">The deployments could not load</p>
              <p class="nd-state__body">
                The server did not answer. Your filters are kept.
              </p>
              <button type="button" class="nd-button nd-button--secondary">
                Try again
              </button>
            </div>
          </td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>
</div>
```
